(ba)༄༅/ /bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo'i don yang dag par bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag yang dag par bsdus pa zhes

tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo'i don yang dag par bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// theg pa chen po'i man ngag yang dag par bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'khor grangs med pa 'dus pa'i nang du bu mo rin chen zhes bya bas mu tig gi se mo do phul nas/ sangs rgyas kyis 'dir bstan pa'i chos 'di bdag gis 'dzin zhing rgyas par bgyid par 'gyur na/ bden pa'i stobs des se mo do 'di/ thub pa'i dbu'i steng du khang pa brtsegs par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag thams cad kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi bkod pa 'di la snang bar gyur cig ces brjod nas phul ba dang*/ de bzhin du gyur pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ngo mtshar du gyur nas sangs rgyas la zhus pa dang*/ bsngags pa mdzad de/ de nas bu mo rin chen gyis bstod nas/ thog mar byang chub sems dpa'i tshul zhus shing gsungs pa'i rjes su bu mos sems bskyed pa rin po che sum cu rtsa gnyis smras pa ni/ gzhan phyir kun mkhyen nyid du sems bskyed dang*// sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob chos 'dzin dge 'dun rgyun// mi gcod phyir dang 'gro la byams phyir dang*// brtse dang sbyin dang khrims dang bzod pa dang*// brtson dang bsam gtan nyid dang shes rab dang*// sems can smin dang kun la sems snyoms dang*// mtha' dbus med pa'i lta ba rtogs pa dang*// tshogs gnyis rdzogs dang sangs rgyas mi 'bral dang*// dam chos tshol dang chos rab ston pa dang*// slob dpon bkur dang nyams pa rjes gzung dang*// dman la brnyas med kun la 'dud pa dang*// theg dman spangs nas theg mchog lam 'god dang*// 'khor bar mi skyo 'du 'dzi med pa dang*// bdag gi bde ba gzhan la smin pa dang*// grol yang 'dus byas yongs su mi 'dor dang*// byang chub mchog chos yongs su bsgrub pa dang*// lta ba med pas 'gro la lta ba dang*/

kun mkhyen don du bskal par mi skyo dang*// rang gi phun tshogs rlom med rgud pa la// 'byor pa sbyor bas sems rab bskyed pa ni// rgyal sras rnams kyi rin chen lta bu yi// sems bskyed sum cu rtsa gnyis de yis bshad// ces pa rnams so// de nas thub pas gsungs pa/ bu mo khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' dag gi sems bskyed pa rin po che la 'jug pa 'di legs par smras pa ni legs so legs so// bu mo gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de dag ni skyes bu dam pa yin te/ yon tan bstan pa mtha' yas so// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nyan thos rin po che dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rin po che las/ sangs rgyas rin po che mi 'byung gi sangs rgyas rin po che las/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rin po che 'byung ngo*// byang chub kyi sangs rgyas rin po che 'byung ngo*// byang chub kyi sems rin po che las/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun rin po che 'byung ngo*// zhes gsungs so// de nas tshig 'ga' zhig gi mthar shā ri'i bus/ bu mo 'dis gang gi tshe gang las sems bskyed/ ces zhus pas/ gsungs pa/ bskal pa grangs med pa'i yang grangs med pa'i gong du 'jig rten gyi khams shin tu rnam par dag pa zhes bya bar sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs/ sku tshe bar gyi bskal pa bcu 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i drung du bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i 'khor los sgyur bar gyur nas/ lo bye ba sum cu rtsa drug tu bsnyen bkur nas sems bskyed do// slar yang lo bye ba phrag bcur bsnyen bkur ro// mthar rab tu byung ngo*// de nas brtsams te spyod pa la zhugs so zhes gsungs so// de nas rim gyis bu mos de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu po gang las grub zhus pas/ gsungs pa/ theg dman lam dman spangs nas byang chub lam// gnas pa brten pas gnas mkhyen stobs thob 'gyur// las dang rnam smin la rton gzhan dag kyang*// rton du 'jug pas lam mkhyen stobs thob bo// de ni 'khor du seng ge'i sgra sgrogs 'gyur// dbang po brtags nas chos ston dbang mkhyen stobs// khams la 'jug cing gnas pas khams mkhyen stobs// mos pa brtags nas ston pas mos pa mkhyen// theg pa kun bslabs bstan pas kun 'gro mkhyen// bsam gtan ting 'dzin lhur len nges brtags pas// dul zhing cang shes gyur pas dgongs pa mkhyen// dge ba chud mi gson zhing bag yod la// dam bcas brtan pas bdag dang gzhan dag gi

/sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i stobs thob bo// sems can spa mi bkong zhing mi shes pa'i// chos la dbang za mi byed snang byed pas// lha mig dag pas 'chi 'pho skye ba mkhyen// zag pa spangs phyir chos dang lam bstan pas// zag pa zad mkhyen stobs ni thob par 'gyur// zhes pas stobs bcu'o// mi 'jigs pa bzhi gang gis thob/ ces zhus pa'i lan du/ chos la dpe mkhyud med pas sems can la// sems snyoms bdog pa kun gtong mnyam nyid thob// tha dad 'du shes bral bas 'khor du ni// byang chub rtogs pa dam 'cha' la mi 'jigs// gang gis bar chad 'gyur zhes rang dang gzhan// mi 'jug pa yis gegs ston 'jigs pa med// dkar po'i chos la mos shing rnam byang gis// lam la bzhugs bstan pas nges 'byung gi /lam ston pa la 'jigs med gsum pa'o// bdag gis shes kyi gzhan gyis mi shes zhes// nga rgyal med cing sdig med sbyangs pa yis// spangs thob ston la mi 'jigs bzhi pa thob// ces pa ste mi 'jigs pa'o// sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad gang gis thob ces zhus pa'i lan du/ lam ston lam chos mtshan mo mar me 'bul// 'gyod dang nyes sel the tshom gcod pa dang*// snang byed mi smod nges tshig dbang mi za// de yis kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin dang*// sgra skad kun la 'jug pa'i gzungs thob pas// 'khrul ba med par chos ston dang po'o// tshig skyon byung rgyal mu cor smra ba spangs// bden smra rtsod med chos la 'jug pa dang*// ye shes lhun grub la dad 'dzin du 'jug /de yi rnam 'phrul rgyal po'i ting 'dzin dang*// sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs mkhas 'bad med pas// ca co med par kun nas chos ston to// rjes dran drug dran dran du 'jug pa dang*// chos rnams thams cad dbang bsgyur ting 'dzin dang*// chos kyi sgron ma'i gzungs mkhas bsnyel ba med// sems can sems bsrung dge ba'i bar mi gcod// chos kun sgyu mar mos shing rlom sems med// mnyam nyid chos dbyings 'dre ba med par bzhugs// de yi chos kun rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid// rnam par spros pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*// kun nas 'khyil ba'i gzungs kyi sgo mkhas pas// mdzad pa lhun grub mnyam gzhag bzhi pa'o// sems dang lta ba phyin ci log med dang*// sgro 'dogs pa dang bdag tu 'du shes med// sems can srog gso gang zag shed las skyes// shed bu rtag chad 'byung 'jig dge mi dge

/kha na ma tho zag bcas zag med dang*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das dang nyon mongs dang*// rnam byang tha dad 'du shes med goms shing*// der bzhugs pa yi mtshan ma med pa dang*// mi zad za ma tog gi gzungs mkhas pas// tha dad 'du shes med chos lnga pa yin// bde dang sdug bsngal 'byor dang nyams pa dang*// bdag gzhan srid zhi mnyam pa nyid rtogs shing*// gzhan yang der 'jug pa dang gnyis la ni// chags las rnam grol ting 'dzin bsgom pa dang*// rgya mtsho phyag rgya'i gzungs la mkhas pa yis// ma brtags btang snyoms med pa drug pa'o// zab dang rgya che'i dge ba tshol bar nges// nyan thos rang rgyal sa spang theg chen las// mi ldog sems can mi 'dor gzhan dag gi /dring la mi 'jog mos dang mos pa yis// 'du byed ting 'dzin rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi// gzungs la mkhas pas ston dang mdzad pa la// skad cig dus mi 'da' ba'ang mnyam gzhag las// mi g.yo 'dun pa nyams med bdun pa'o// bsam dang sbyor bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' dang*// bla ma bsten dang yongs 'dri bsnyen bkur dang*// sems can smin dang sangs rgyas zhing sbyong dang*// chos 'dzin pa dang mngon par byang chub phyir// ston dang 'khrul pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang*// brtson 'grus 'du byed ting 'dzin bsgom pa dang*// rdzu 'phrul dam pa'i cho 'phrul thob pa yi// brtson 'grus nyams med 'di ni brgyad pa'o// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i chos dran pa// gang gi lus tshor chos sems mi dmigs dang*// mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med mi sdug par// dran yang mtshan bde'i lus bsgrub gzhan dag gi /sdug bsngal tshor ba zhi phyir snying rje dang*// byang sems bdag nyid mtha' dbus med pa yi// chos la 'jug pa'i dran pa dam pa dang*// spong ba'i 'du byed ldan pa'i ting 'dzin dang*// kun brjod pa yi cho 'phrul dam pa yis// dran pa nyams pa med par lung ston pa// 'di ni rgyal ba'i ma 'dres dgu pa'o// rgya chen rno dang zab pa'i shes rab dang*// zil gyis mi gnon nyan thos rang rgyal gyi// mi dpogs lhag dang gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog

/thos pas mi ngoms chos tshol shes rab kyis// bla ma bkur byed mchod phyir kun gtong ba// sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pas gsal byas shing*// spyod pa'i 'du byed ting 'dzin bsgoms pa dang*// rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dam pa yis// shes rab nyams med ma 'dres bcu pa'o// 'du 'dzi spangs shing dben dang rnal 'byor gzhol// rnam thar gsum gyi sgrib med rnam thar bskyed// shes rab dang ldan bdud kyi yul las 'das// ye shes yul rdzogs byed cing sgrib pa spang*// zab mo'i chos ston rton pa bzhi dang ldan// lta dang nyon mongs mi mthun phyogs kun spang*// dri med snying po'i ting 'dzin bsgoms pa dang*// chos kun snang ldan gzungs la mkhas pa yis// rnam grol nyams pa med pa bcu gcig pa// ye shes rnam dag nyams med sbyangs pa las// byung bas yul gang nyon mongs bcas pa dang*// nyon mongs med sogs khyad par gang ldan pa// nges dang ma nges so so'i skye bo dang*// 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams dang bden pa rnams// shes bya mngon du mi byed gzhan dag gis// shes phyir chos ston bstan pa de la yang*// gnod med chos dang mthun par zhugs pa dang*// lugs 'byung bzlog pa'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis so// shes shing byed med dus gsum mnyam nyid dang*// bsam med don rnams ston pa rgyal ba'i bka'// rtsod med 'byung dang 'jig tshul dang bcas shing*// mtha' lta ba las rnam par 'das pa'i tshul// shes shing de bzhin gzhan la bstan pa dang*// stobs bkod pa yi ting 'dzin bsgom pa dang*// mtha' yas mkhyen pa'i gzungs la mkhas pa yis// ji skad smos pa'i ma 'dres de dag la// dbang 'byor rnam grol ye shes bcu gnyis pa// rtogs pas bsdus pa'i chos drug go /ye shes dam pa de 'dra dbang byas pa// g.yo sgyus bslu dang tshul 'chos nyid dang yang*// chags dang sdang med tshangs par spyod pa yis// lus kyis bdag gzhan don 'grub byed pa dang*// gzugs rnams kun tu ston pa'i ting 'dzin dang*// kun nas snang ba'i gzungs la mkhas pa yis// thub pa'i sku gzungs sna tshogs kun ston pa// ye shes rjes 'brangs lus las bcu gsum pa// ye shes dbang gis sgyu sogs spangs pa'i ngag

/brdzun dang phra ma rtsub 'khyal rnam par spangs// phan dang ran dang chos kyi don ldan pas// bdag gzhan don grub byed dang rin po che'i// 'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin dang 'khor gsum gyi// gzungs la mkhas pas brjod med mtshan nyid kyi// brjod pa kun ston kun tu 'jug pa yis// ye shes rjes 'brangs ngag las bcu bzhi pa// ye shes dbang gis sgyu sogs spangs pa'i yid// brnab sems gnod sems log par lta bral zhing*// yang dag lta dang tshad med bzhi dang ni// brjod pa med pa'i byang chub sems ldan pa'i// rang gzhan las bsgrub da ltar byung ba yis// sangs rgyas mngon sum bzhugs pa'i ting 'dzin dang*// brnab sems rnyog pa med pa'i gzungs mkhas pa'i// spros pa med par 'gro ba'i yid shes shing*// mnyam pa nyid du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi// rjes su 'brang ba'i yid las bco lnga pa// phrin las kyis bsdus pa'i chos gsum mo// 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs rnams ye shes kyi// chags med brnyes pa yid gnyis med pa yi// de yis sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa yi// lhun grub don kun bsgrub la mi skrag dang*// rang yang der mos gzhan dag der 'jug dang*// dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang ni// gzi brjid ldan pa'i gzungs la mkhas pa yis// 'das pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i// ye shes gzigs par 'jug pa bcu drug pa'o// ma 'ongs dus kyi rgyal ba'ang de lta bur// nges par shes shing rang yang der mos dang*// gzhan 'jug byed dang smon lam yang dag par// 'phags pa'i ting 'dzin seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i/ gzungs la mkhas pas ma 'ongs dus kun la// ma chags ye shes bcu bdun brnyes par 'gyur// de ltar zhugs pa'i rgyal ba'ang de lta bur// shes shing bdag mos gzhan yang der 'jug dang*// shin tu dkar ba dri med phyag rgya yis// ting nge 'dzin dang rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi// gzungs la mkhas pas da ltar dus dag la// ma thogs ma chags ye shes gzigs pa gang*// 'jug par 'gyur 'di ma 'dres bco brgyad pa// de nas bu mo rin chen gyis sngon dag pa gang la zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis mngon par 'grub ces pa'i lan du/

dam bca' brtan pas zhabs mnyam pa// sna tshogs byin pas 'khor lo'i mtshan// khyad du ma bsang rting pa yangs// 'gro kun chos kyis bskyabs pa yis// sor mo ring dang gzhan bsdums pas// phyag zhabs dra bas 'brel pa dang*// gos byin pa yis gzhon sha can// bza' btung byin pas bdun mtho ba// chos bzung ba yis e n+ya'i byin// gsang tshig sbas shing 'khrig pa'i chos// spangs pas sba ba sbubs su nub// rgya chen dge bas seng ge'i stod// dge ba yang dag spyad pa yis// thal gong rab rgyas 'jigs pa las// dbugs phyung ba yis dpung mgo zlum// gzhan gyi don bsgrubs phyag ring dang*// dge bcus mi ngoms sku rnam dag /nad pa rnams la sman byin pas// mgrin pa dri med dung lta bu// dge ba'i sbyor tshogs seng ge'i 'gram// sems can sems mnyam tshems bzhi bcu// mi mthun mthun byas tshems thags bzang*// yid 'ong byin pas mnyam pa'i tshems// sgo gsum bsrungs pas mche ba dkar// bden par smras pas ljags ring dang*// thags bzang byin pas ro bro'i mchog /tshig sdom snyan par smras pa yis// tshangs dbyangs ka la piṅga'i dbyangs// byams pas gzhan don mthon mthing spyan// sgyu med ba yi rdzi ma dang*// bsngags 'os bsngags pas mdzod spu dkar// bla mar gus pas gtsug tor mchog /sems las rung bas pags pa bsrab// mal stan byin pas gser mdog dang*// 'du 'dzi spangs pas mdzod spu mdzes// gdams pa rjes su mthun bzung pas// ba spu'i rtse mo g.yas su 'khyil// brdeg btsog spangs pas dbu skra mthing*// gzhan dag ting 'dzin la sbyar bas// n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab// sku gzugs mchod rten bcos pa dang*// 'jigs las gzhan dag dbugs phyung dang*// nyams chung bde la bkod pa yis// stobs po che yi mchog tu 'gyur// de nas bu mos yon tan de dag bsgrub pa thun mong gi rgyu byang chub sems dpa'i chos dang chos spyod pa'i tshul zhus shing rgyas par gsungs te/

bsdu ba'i skabs su bu mo byang chub sems dpa' gang 'di lta bur chos thams cad khong du chud nas/ sems can gzhan dag 'dul ba'i phyir/ 'khor ba na'ang spyod pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos nyid las kyang mi g.yo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yang dag pa'i phul yin no// zhes gsungs so// de nas shā ri'i bus dris pa'i lan du/ bu mos byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la rgyas 'debs pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i phyag rgya bshad nas/ lam dang 'bras bu thun mong gi tshul rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ bu mos ci'i slad du/ theg pa 'di ni theg pa chen po zhes bgyi/ zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis theg pa 'di ni sems can thams cad la skabs 'byed pa rgya che ba'o// zhes bya ba la sogs pa che ba'i tshul lnga bcu rtsa drug gis theg pa chen po'i chos kyi che ba gsungs nas/ slar yang bu mo rin chen gyis theg pa chen po la bar du gcod par 'gyur ba'i chos du mchis zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bar du gcod pa'i chos sum cu rtsa gnyis gsungs pa ni 'di lta ste/ nyan thos rang rgyal brgya byin sogs 'dod dang*// skye la gnas 'dun tshangs par spyod pa dang*// dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshul gcig la chags dang*// longs spyod chags dang sems can mnyam mi sbyin// tshul khrims lhod dang byang sems mi bsrung dang*// gnod sems khong khro'i bag chags kyis bsgos dang*// zhum dang brjed ngas thob pa don mi gnyer// spyod pa med dang 'phags min tshul gnas dang*// nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal 'phel ba dang*// lus ngag sems las yongs su ma dag dang*// dam chos mi bsrung dpe mkhyud byed pa dang*// bsdu dngos 'dor dang dgar 'gyur chos gtong dang*// sdig grogs brten dang byang chub mi bsngo dang*// dge ba chung ngus rlom sems byed pa dang*// thabs med blo dang dkon mchog mi bsngags dang*// byang chub sems dpa' la ni gnod sems dang*// ma thos chos spang bdud las mi shes dang*// rgyang 'phen pa yi gsang tshig 'dzin pa dang*// sems can smin par mi byed 'khor ba yi// yongs su skyo ba 'di ni sum cu gnyis// zhes gsungs nas/

bar du gcod pa de dag sel bar byed pa theg pa chen po rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i chos kyang sum cu rtsa gnyis gsungs pa/ 'di lta ste/ gsol ba ma btab sems can bshes 'gyur dang*// 'jig rten 'du 'dzi byed la dga' med dang*// dge ba'i tshogs la bsam pa brtan pa dang*// zhum pa med dang rnyog pa med sems dang*// spyod lam rnam mi rtog pas lus dag dang*// ji skad smras bzhin byed pas ngag dag dang*// byang chub sems mi yod rabs sems dag dang*// lan la mi re ba yi sbyin pa dag /bslab pa 'chal pa skyob pas tshul khrims dag /lus srog mi lta ba yi bzod pa dag /mi 'jigs stobs rdzogs byed pas brtson 'grus dag /nyon mongs zil gyis gnon pas bsam gtan dag /bag chags yang dag 'joms pas shes rab dag /bdud las yongs su spangs pas sems pa dang*// kha 'og lus 'grub byed pas yi dam brtan// 'gro smin byed pas bsdu dngos mi 'dor dang*// dam chos bsrungs pas thub la byas pa gzo// byang chub chos rdzogs byed pas mi skyo dang*// shes rab zab mo yongs su rdzogs byed pas// thos pas mi ngoms pa dang gong ma'i tshul// shes pas rang gi gnas la mi chags dang*// gtsug tor bltar mi mthong bar bya ba'i phyir// nga rgyal med pa'i sems kyis nyan pa dang*// rgyu rkyen shes pas chos dang 'gal med dang*// nor bdun thob phyir dbul ba med pa dang*// rang dbang thob pas gzhan dbang ma gyur dang*// tshogs kyi bsgrub pas nyon mongs zhi byed pas// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rig pa bsgrub pa yis// zhi gnas tshogs dang rnam grol bsgrub pa yis// lhag mthong tshogs dang sgo gsum bsgom pa yis// rnam par thar pa'i sgo mo 'byed pa dang*// sems can ji snyed pa yi khong chud pas// nad zhi ba dang mi skye chos bzod pas// zad dang skye ba med pa shes pa dang*// chos la nan tan lhur byed lung ston pa// 'di dag rnam par dag byed sum cu gnyis// zhes gsungs nas mthar brgya byin la sogs pa la yongs su gtad de/

'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yang rjes su yi rang ngo*// de ltar theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi /mdo sde bsdus te bshad pa'i dge ba yis// 'gro kun theg pa chen po'i lam zhugs nas// theg chen 'bras bu'i dpal gyis 'byor gyur cig /theg pa chen po'i man ngag ces bya ba/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo'i don yang dag par bsdus pa 'phags pas dpal sa skyar me mo glang gi lo/ dbyar zla 'bring po la myur du bris pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
